in_marathi.name: Maloy
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maloy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maloy is a Hindi name, derived from the Sanskrit word 'Malati', which means 'Little One' or 'Young One'. It is also associated with the Maloy tree, which symbolizes strength and calmness. Maloy is a unisex name, but is commonly used for boys.
